title: dns/static_dns introduces syslog errors affecting following tests for not closing dhclient after starting it
author: byu343
body:

**Description**

We see syslog errors as below in the tests running after dns/static_dns:
Feb 8 02:33:31.993838 pkz402 ERR dhclient[10764]: send_packet: No such device or address
Feb 8 02:33:31.994116 pkz402 ERR dhclient[10764]: dhclient.c:2446: Failed to send 300 byte long packet over Ethernet37 interface.

The cause is that dns/static_dns starts dhclient (running in the background), but not closes it before the end of test: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/202311/tests/dns/static_dns/test_static_dns.py#L123

This affect multiple tests running after dns/static_dns. The fix should be like stopping dhclient properly in the test.

linkedPullRequests.author: nhe-NV
linkedPullRequests.body:
fix #11681

When do the dhclient, if not specify the management port, it will also do dhclient other port,and may cause some error msg. To avoid this, need to specify the management port when do the dhclient, and kill the deamon after the test finish.
